posts.body_html: Holy Toledo, have you taken measurements of this thing? Seems like it's bigger than the biggest wild psitt Barry Rice has ever seen... if you click through these three slides he says that the heads on that plant were 2.2 inches tall, but it looks like yours might be bigger than that! www.sarracenia.com/trips/fl032010/im43.html

posts.body_html: If measuring it the way Barry did,  then yes, my biggest trap most likely exceeds 2.2 inches.    the picture he took suggests the measurement accounts for the curvature of the trap, not just "linear inches."
